# Conventional Commit Guidelines
Always write commit messages adhering strictly to Conventional Commits:
- Format: `<type>(<scope>): <short summary>`
- Allowed types: `feat`, `fix`, `docs`, `style`, `refactor`, `perf`, `test`, `build`, `ci`, `chore`.
- Use imperative mood in the subject (e.g., "add feature", not "added feature").
- Do not capitalize the first letter of the summary.
- Do not add a period at the end of the header line.
